entities.summary: Ken Ishii (ケン・イシイ) is a Japanese DJ and record producer from Sapporo. He graduated from Hitotsubashi University. He has released work under his own name as well as under the pseudonyms FLR, Flare, UTU, Yoga, and Rising Sun. Ken Ishii was a composers & musicians from Sapporo (b. 1970-05-12, Sapporo). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
